headline: Frontline Flux Intensifies Across Six Sectors
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the tempo of strategic‑base exchanges has shifted. Weathered Expanse now leads with thirty‑eight flips in the past day, its butcher’s bill climbing to 155,387 Colonial and 170,915 Warden dead and 7,744 fresh enlistments per hour, both casualty streams accelerating. Fishermans Row remains hot but eases to thirty‑five flips; Colonial losses are modest at sixty‑seven while Warden casualties rise to two‑hundred‑one and enlistments cool to one‑ninety per hour. Stlican Shelf drops to twenty flips yet casualties surge — 4,586 Colonial and 6,963 Warden — with enlistments steady at seven‑sixty‑five. Linn Mercy holds at seventeen flips, driven by Lathair, recording 3,884 Colonial and 6,537 Warden losses and 903 enlistments; casualties accelerate while recruitment cools. Mooring County falls to eleven flips but sees 4,000 Colonial and 3,438 Warden dead and 896 enlistments, all rates accelerating. New activity appears at Farranac Coast (five flips, 1,652 Colonial and 2,757 Warden casualties, 498 enlistments) and Stonecradle (five flips, 5,068 Colonial and 7,349 Warden casualties, 823 enlistments). Quiet northern Warden‑held sectors and deep Colonial interiors remain static.
